ideas.pitch: A complete, self-hostable hackathon submission and judging pipeline that boots instantly via Docker Compose, including offline SQLite data seeding, automated eligibility checks, and normalization scoring.
ideas.title: RaptorPipe: Zero-Config Dockerized Hackathon Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: The prompt explicitly states the winning project will be forked, self-hosted, and put into production for Hackathon Raptors. Building a bulletproof, zero-config local engine that fulfills the exact lifecycle specification hits the core evaluation metric.

ideas.pitch: An embedded AI agent pipeline that automatically ingests submitted GitHub repositories, verifies local Docker execution compatibility, runs static analysis, and normalizes scores against a rubric.
ideas.title: AgentJudge: Automated Semantic Code and Pitch Review Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leveraging local LLMs or lightweight evaluation agents directly solves the massive bottleneck of manual preliminary judging for Hackathon Raptors events.

ideas.pitch: A transparent scoring normalization engine with statistical outlier detection for judges, paired with a local batch certificate generator and immutable verification hashing.
ideas.title: CertGen Vault: Cryptographic Credentialing & Result Normalization
ideas.why_it_could_win: Handling the final stages of the hackathon lifecycle—results, normalization, and certificates—solves administrative pain points that organizers face after every single event.

ideas.pitch: An embedded team formation portal and repository submission wizard featuring real-time local collaboration states, automated schema validation, and instant fixture seeding.
ideas.title: TeamSync Local: Offline-First Matchmaking and Submission Portal
ideas.why_it_could_win: By nailing the registration and team formation phase of the pipeline with a delightful local-first interface, it directly addresses the onboarding friction of hackathon participants.

ideas.pitch: A verification module that sits between submission and judging to detect plagiarism, track code provenance across commits, and enforce strict eligibility criteria with zero external API dependencies.
ideas.title: RaptorAudit: Automated Data Lineage & Submission Integrity Guard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Organizers struggle heavily with verifying submission authenticity and metadata integrity. This directly targets the eligibility and archiving hurdles mentioned in the prompt.
